items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: A fellow used to run the place by the name of Vicki Adams.

ctx.x: Yeah, way up there. A fellow used to run the place by the name of Vicki Adams. And he had danced there every Sunday night. And I played there with Ori on several occasions. Then after that, that was about in the year.
Who else was in the band with Ori at that time, can you remember?
